# UnifiedOntologyResult { #dyf.UnifiedOntologyResult }

```python
UnifiedOntologyResult(
    ontology,
    main_nodes,
    outlier_nodes,
    excluded_nodes,
    bridge_edges,
    main_threshold,
    outlier_threshold,
)
```

Result of building a unified ontology from embedding space.

The unified ontology combines:
1. Main ontology (high similarity threshold) for dense regions
2. Outlier ontology (lower threshold) for sparse regions
3. Bridge edges connecting the two

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name              | Type                                      | Description                                            |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| ontology          | [DAGTaxonomy](`dyf.ontology.DAGTaxonomy`) | The unified DAGTaxonomy                                |
| main_nodes        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)  | Indices of nodes from main ontology                    |
| outlier_nodes     | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)  | Indices of nodes from outlier ontology                 |
| excluded_nodes    | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)  | Indices of double outliers (excluded)                  |
| bridge_edges      | [int](`int`)                              | Number of edges connecting main and outlier components |
| main_threshold    | [float](`float`)                          | Similarity threshold used for main ontology            |
| outlier_threshold | [float](`float`)                          | Similarity threshold used for outlier ontology         |
